title: Sunshine PonyCon
description: Live music, costumes, movement, and the people who made Sunshine PonyCon feel electric.
story: These photographs follow the music and movement inside Sunshine PonyCon, from quiet acoustic performances to full-band sets and the energy moving through the convention floor. I focused on the smaller expressions between the larger moments: concentration before a note, friends stepping into frame, and the audience becoming part of the show.
